Maya Patel: Postmortem follow-up: recurring vendor dependency issues — cloud auth rate limits causing token storms, and intermittent model-registry write stalls. We need a compact remediation plan, owners, and a cadence to review recurrence trends.
Omar Ruiz: Agreed. Let's avoid band-aids. Propose three buckets: immediate mitigation (circuit breakers + local token pad), observability (per-region auth SLAs + spike correlation), and vendor engagement (formal RCA + mitigation SLA).
Li Wei: I'll do immediate mitigations: add a soft-fail path for low-priority writes, a small local token-pad (cache TTL + 30s) and a circuit-breaker that opens on consecutive 5 write errors. ETA: 72h.
Hannah Cole: I'll own observability: new panels for auth.refresh.success by region, registry.write.p95/p99, and a correlation dashboard that overlays vendor-side throttle indicators (if provided). Also add a weekly "recurrence digest" email. ETA: 4 days.
Maya Patel: Vendor lane? We need a named contact, ask for log slices, and request edge-side smoothing for refreshes. Also ask vendor to confirm whether limits are per-IP, per-customer, or per-tenant.
Omar Ruiz: I can own vendor outreach this sprint. I'll prepare the evidence bundle and request a joint debug + SLA amendment. ETA: Thu COB.
Li Wei: Runbook snippet I added to the draft:
```
- If auth.refresh.success_rate < 95% for 10m -> page infra oncall
- Infra oncall: enable local token-pad and flip registry to degraded-mode for low-priority writes
- If registry.write.p99 > 2s for 5m -> abort heavy batch writes, notify owners
- Escalate to vendor contact when vendor indicators present
```
Maya Patel: Good. Also add a synthetic: every 15m post a tiny model-tag and validate full token exchange + write. Failure -> auto-create INC-3077. Who can add it?
Li Wei: I can wire the synthetic into the smoke harness, ~2h. Will emit metric synthetic.registry.heartbeat and a failed_run_count.
Hannah Cole: I'll create alerts: synthetic.registry.heartbeat_failures > 1 in 30m -> page. Also add a trend email for ops/pd weekly.
ops-bot: Created ticket INC-3077: "registry-synthetic-heartbeat-and-vendor-correlation". Link: https://issues.redwood/INC-3077
Omar Ruiz: Vendor ticket VND-7810 opened. Requested log slices for dates we observed the storms and asked for a debug session next Friday.
Maya Patel: Ownership summary (for this thread):
- Immediate mitigation (circuit-breaker, token-pad, degraded writes): Li Wei
- Observability + dashboards + synthetic + alerts: Hannah Cole
- Vendor outreach & SLA ask: Omar Ruiz
- Incident tracking & checklist: ops-bot
Maya Patel: Proposed deadlines: mitigations 72h, observability 4 days, vendor outreach Thu, vendor debug Fri. We'll meet next Monday to review the first full week of synthetic runs and decide on longer-term fixes (regional registry replicas, request-based throttling). Keep updates here and paste PRs/runbook diffs. :eyes:
